Shader.Name: tom/ReflectionProbeControl
Shader.Tooltip: Control material only. Requires Tom Probe Runtime 0.2. World-aligned bounds ignore Studio rotation and scale. Use Size and Offset parameters.
Shader.Property: Enable both capture requests and lighting contribution. Studio item visibility is an additional gate; it does not modify this saved value.
Lighting multiplier, 0 to 8. Applies without recapture. SH affects diffuse indirect only; reflection uses native probe intensity.
Higher values take precedence in overlapping bounds. SH selects one volume per renderer; this is not a multi-volume per-pixel blend.
Integer group number, 0 to 999. Used by RefreshScope=1; it does not restrict which objects receive lighting.
0 current item; 1 enabled items with the same group number; 2 all enabled Tom probes. SH finishes before reflection in a shared refresh batch.
Change 0 to 1 or 1 to 0 to request one capture. Loading saved values does not replay this command. Never auto-reset this value.
0 load only; 1 debounce position/configuration changes; 2 timed updates; 3 manual. Capture settings changes invalidate data in every mode. Rotation and scale are ignored.
Wait for stable restored material settings, then capture on load/enable. A late restored sky invalidates the capture automatically. Scene files store settings, not captured cubemaps/SH atlases.
Seconds between requests, not a guaranteed completion period. Requests coalesce while busy. SH minimum is 5 seconds.
Near clipping plane for every capture face. Not a spherical radius or reliable self-exclusion. Use capture layers to omit characters.
Far clipping plane in world units for each capture face. Clamped above NearClip; a small value omits distant environment.
Maximum shadow distance during capture. Does not change the main view's shadow-distance setting.
0 excludes named Chara and Action/Chara layers; 1 includes them; 2 uses the two custom 16-bit masks. Custom-layer characters need a custom mask. This is not per-object exclusion.
Custom mask, bits 0-15 as an unsigned integer. Used only by CapturePreset=2. Values are rounded.
Custom mask, bits 16-31 as an unsigned integer. Used only by CapturePreset=2. Split halves avoid float precision loss.
1 snapshots RenderSettings.skybox, including exposure and rotation, for all capture faces; 0 uses the linear HDR Background Color. Does not bake main-camera postprocessing.
Linear RGB radiance when Skybox=0 or no scene sky exists. HDR capture preserves values above 1. Not a display color; no additional sRGB decode. Requires matching TomProbe 0.2.2 zipmod and DLLs.
World-axis X extent of the influence bounds. Ignores item/parent rotation and scale; changing SH bounds requires recapture.
World-axis Y extent of the influence bounds. Ignores item/parent rotation and scale; changing SH bounds requires recapture.
World-axis Z extent of the influence bounds. Ignores item/parent rotation and scale; changing SH bounds requires recapture.
World-axis X offset from the item's world position. Ignores item rotation and scale.
World-axis Y offset from the item's world position. Ignores item rotation and scale.
World-axis Z offset from the item's world position. Ignores item rotation and scale.
0=256, 1=512, 2=1024 pixels per face. Rounded and clamped; no reimport required.
HDR capture. Changing HDR rebuilds the internal runtime probe and requests a new capture; the Studio item is retained.
Unity box-projected reflection using the explicit world bounds. Requires receiver shader support.
Native reflection blend distance at the volume boundary, in world units. Requires receiver shader support.
0=AllFacesAtOnce, 1=IndividualFaces, 2=NoTimeSlicing. Applied on the next capture. NoTimeSlicing can stall a frame.
